question: How many days of paid annual leave are full-time employees entitled to per year?
reference_answer: Full-time employees are entitled to 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

question: How many days of paid sick leave do employees receive per year?
reference_answer: Employees are entitled to 10 days of paid sick leave per year.

question: How many casual leave days are employees entitled to per year?
reference_answer: Employees are entitled to 6 days of casual leave per year for personal emergencies or unforeseen circumstances.

question: How many weeks of paid maternity leave does NimbusWorks provide?
reference_answer: Employees who have completed at least 12 months of continuous service are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave.

question: How many weeks of paid paternity leave does NimbusWorks provide?
reference_answer: Male employees and non-birth parents are entitled to 2 weeks of paid paternity leave following the birth or adoption of a child.

question: What is the maximum number of unused annual leave days that can be carried forward to the next year?
reference_answer: Employees may carry forward a maximum of 5 unused leave days to the following calendar year.

question: When do carried-forward annual leave days expire?
reference_answer: Carried-forward leave expires on March 31 of the following year.

question: How many paid bereavement days are employees entitled to for the death of an immediate family member?
reference_answer: Employees are entitled to 3 paid days for the death of an immediate family member (spouse, child, parent, sibling).

question: How many paid bereavement days are provided for the death of an extended family member such as a grandparent?
reference_answer: 1 paid day is provided for extended family members such as grandparents and in-laws.

question: How far in advance must a leave request of 4 or more consecutive days be submitted?
reference_answer: Leave of 4 or more consecutive days must be requested at least 2 weeks in advance.

question: After how many consecutive sick days is a medical certificate required?
reference_answer: A medical certificate is required for any sick leave exceeding 3 consecutive days.

question: What is the probation period for new employees at NimbusWorks?
reference_answer: The standard probation period is 3 months from the date of joining.

question: What is the notice period for employees below the Vice President level after probation?
reference_answer: The standard notice period after probation is 30 days for all employees below the Vice President level.

question: What notice period is required for Vice Presidents and above?
reference_answer: Vice Presidents and above are required to provide 90 days notice.

question: What are the core working hours that all employees must be available during?
reference_answer: All employees must be available during core hours of 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM in their local timezone.

question: When are formal performance reviews conducted at NimbusWorks?
reference_answer: NimbusWorks conducts formal performance reviews twice per year: in June (mid-year check-in) and December (annual review).

question: What triggers a Performance Improvement Plan at NimbusWorks?
reference_answer: Employees who receive a rating of 2 or below in any two consecutive reviews may be placed on a 90-day Performance Improvement Plan (PIP).

question: Within how many business days must final pay be processed after an employee's last working day?
reference_answer: Final pay including accrued unused leave is processed within 7 business days of the final working day.

question: What is the maximum hotel accommodation rate for domestic travel?
reference_answer: Hotel accommodation for domestic travel is reimbursable up to $200 per night.

question: What is the maximum hotel accommodation rate for international travel?
reference_answer: Hotel accommodation for international travel is reimbursable up to $300 per night.

question: What is the per diem meal allowance for domestic business travel?
reference_answer: The per diem meal allowance for domestic travel is $50 per day.

question: What is the per diem meal allowance for international business travel?
reference_answer: The per diem meal allowance for international travel is $80 per day.

question: What flight class is permitted for flights under 6 hours?
reference_answer: Economy class is required for flights under 6 hours.

question: What flight class is permitted for flights 6 hours or longer?
reference_answer: Business class is permitted for flights 6 hours or longer.

question: What is the mileage reimbursement rate for personal vehicle use?
reference_answer: Personal vehicle use is reimbursed at the current IRS standard mileage rate of $0.67 per mile as of 2024.

question: Within how many days must expense reports be submitted after the expense is incurred?
reference_answer: Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the expense being incurred.

question: What is the maximum travel advance employees can request?
reference_answer: Employees may request a travel advance of up to $1,000 for pre-approved trips.

question: Within how many days must a travel advance be reconciled after returning from a trip?
reference_answer: The travel advance must be reconciled against actual expenses within 15 days of return.

question: What is the minimum expense amount that requires a receipt for reimbursement?
reference_answer: Receipts are required for all expenses over $25.

question: What is the minimum password length required for NimbusWorks accounts?
reference_answer: All NimbusWorks accounts must use passwords that are a minimum of 12 characters in length.

question: How often must passwords be rotated at NimbusWorks?
reference_answer: Passwords must be rotated every 90 days.

question: How many previous passwords must not be reused?
reference_answer: Passwords must not reuse the last 10 passwords.

question: Since when has MFA been mandatory for all NimbusWorks employees?
reference_answer: MFA has been mandatory for all employees since January 1, 2023.

question: Within how many hours must a security incident be reported after detection?
reference_answer: Security incidents must be reported to security@nimbusworks.com within 2 hours of detection.

question: Within how many days must a critical security patch be applied to company laptops?
reference_answer: Operating systems must be updated within 14 days of a critical security patch release.

question: What is the automatic screen lock timeout required on company laptops?
reference_answer: Company-issued laptops must have automatic screen lock after 5 minutes of inactivity.

question: How many days per week are employees required to be in the office under the hybrid work policy?
reference_answer: Employees are required to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week.

question: Which days of the week are the preferred in-office days?
reference_answer: The preferred in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday to maximize team collaboration.

question: What is the one-time home office equipment stipend for remote and hybrid employees?
reference_answer: The company provides a $1,500 one-time home office equipment stipend for remote and hybrid employees.

question: What is the monthly internet allowance for remote and hybrid employees?
reference_answer: Remote and hybrid employees receive a $50 per month internet allowance, paid as a taxable addition to monthly payroll.

question: What is the maximum number of consecutive days an employee can work abroad without prior HR and Legal approval?
reference_answer: Employees may not work remotely from outside their country of employment for more than 20 consecutive days without prior approval from HR and Legal.

question: What is the minimum internet connection speed required for working from home?
reference_answer: Employees working from home must maintain a reliable internet connection with a minimum speed of 25 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload.

question: What percentage of the medical insurance monthly premium does NimbusWorks pay?
reference_answer: NimbusWorks pays 80% of the monthly medical insurance premium; the employee pays 20%.

question: What is NimbusWorks's 401(k) matching policy?
reference_answer: NimbusWorks matches 100% of employee contributions up to 4% of gross salary, with immediate vesting from day one.

question: What is the annual learning and development budget per employee?
reference_answer: Every employee receives $1,000 per year for learning and development, covering courses, books, conferences, and certifications.

question: How much does NimbusWorks reimburse per month for gym membership or fitness subscriptions?
reference_answer: NimbusWorks reimburses up to $50 per month for gym membership, fitness apps, or wellness equipment.

question: What life insurance coverage does NimbusWorks provide?
reference_answer: NimbusWorks provides basic life insurance coverage of 3 times the employee's annual base salary at no cost.

question: How many free counseling sessions does the Employee Assistance Program (EAP) provide per issue per year?
reference_answer: The EAP through ComPsych provides 6 free counseling sessions per issue per year.

question: What is the employee referral bonus at NimbusWorks?
reference_answer: The employee referral bonus is $3,000 for a successful hire.

question: On which days and times are production deployments permitted?
reference_answer: Production deployments are permitted only on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM Pacific Time.

question: How many code review approvals are required for a feature branch merge to main?
reference_answer: Feature branches merged to main require a minimum of 1 approval.

question: How many approvals are required for a direct merge (hotfix) to main?
reference_answer: Direct merges to main require a minimum of 2 approvals, at least one from a senior engineer.

question: What is the required response time for a P1 incident?
reference_answer: P1 incidents (major feature broken, affecting more than 20% of users) require a response within 1 hour.

question: What is the required response time for a P0 incident by the on-call engineer?
reference_answer: On-call engineers are expected to respond to P0 pages within 5 minutes, at any hour.

question: What is the weekly on-call compensation for carrying the pager?
reference_answer: On-call compensation is $200 flat per week for carrying the pager, plus $50 per incident response outside business hours.

question: What is the minimum code coverage requirement for new modules?
reference_answer: New modules must have a minimum of 80% code coverage, checked in CI.

question: How many business days in advance must a travel request be submitted?
reference_answer: All business travel must be approved before booking, and the travel request must be submitted at least 10 business days before the travel date.

question: What approval is required for a business trip estimated to cost over $2,000?
reference_answer: Travel requests over $2,000 require VP approval.

question: How many weeks in advance must HR be notified for international travel for visa verification?
reference_answer: Employees must notify HR at least 3 weeks in advance for international travel for visa and travel document verification.

question: What is the acceptable gift value threshold before it must be reported to management?
reference_answer: Employees may accept gifts of a nominal value under $50 from vendors or customers. Gifts valued at $50 or more must be reported to the employee's manager and recorded in the Gifts Register.

question: What is the anonymous ethics hotline number for reporting Code of Conduct violations?
reference_answer: The anonymous hotline for reporting violations is +1-800-555-0177, available 24/7.

question: How long are financial records retained under the data handling policy?
reference_answer: Financial records are retained for 7 years, as required by law in the US, UK, and EU.

question: How long is customer data retained after account closure?
reference_answer: Customer data is permanently deleted within 30 days of account closure.

question: What encryption standard is used for data at rest at NimbusWorks?
reference_answer: NimbusWorks uses AES-256 encryption for all stored data at rest, including databases, file storage, and backups.

question: Within how many hours must employee access be revoked after an employee departs?
reference_answer: Access is revoked within 24 hours of an employee's departure.

question: Within how many hours must a data breach affecting EU residents be reported to the supervisory authority?
reference_answer: NimbusWorks will notify the relevant supervisory authority within 72 hours if required following a personal data breach affecting EU/EEA residents.

question: What rating scale is used for performance reviews at NimbusWorks?
reference_answer: All employees are rated on a 1 to 5 scale: 1 = Needs Improvement, 2 = Developing, 3 = Meets Expectations, 4 = Exceeds Expectations, 5 = Outstanding.

question: By what date must employees complete their self-assessment in a review cycle?
reference_answer: Employees must complete their self-assessment by the 7th of the review month.

question: When do compensation adjustments from the December performance review take effect?
reference_answer: Compensation changes from the annual review take effect on February 1 of the following year.

question: How long must an employee be in their current role to be eligible for promotion?
reference_answer: Employees must have been in their current role for a minimum of 12 months to be eligible for promotion.

question: How long does an onboarding buddy program last for new hires?
reference_answer: Every new hire is paired with an onboarding buddy for their first 90 days.

question: How long must the GDPR Awareness Training take and when must it be completed?
reference_answer: GDPR Awareness Training is 30 minutes and must be completed within 30 days of joining.

question: What are the three NimbusWorks office locations?
reference_answer: NimbusWorks has offices in San Francisco (425 Market Street, Suite 1800), New York (1 World Trade Center, Suite 8500), and London (1 Canada Square, Canary Wharf).

question: When and how often is the All-Hands meeting held?
reference_answer: All-Hands meetings are held every other Monday at 10:00 AM Pacific time.

question: What is the pre-tax commuter benefit cap per month in 2024?
reference_answer: Pre-tax commuter benefits are available up to $315 per month for transit and parking, per the IRS 2024 limit.

question: Can a new employee who just joined work remotely during their first month?
reference_answer: No. New employees are expected to be in the office 5 days a week during their first 30 days of employment, per the remote work policy. Remote work eligibility also requires completing the 3-month probation period.

question: If an employee earns $100,000 per year and contributes 4% to their 401(k), how much will NimbusWorks contribute?
reference_answer: NimbusWorks matches 100% of employee contributions up to 4% of gross salary. If an employee earns $100,000 and contributes 4% ($4,000), NimbusWorks adds $4,000.

question: What mandatory training modules must all new employees complete within 30 days of joining?
reference_answer: All new employees must complete three mandatory trainings within 30 days: Security Awareness Training (1 hour), GDPR Awareness Training (30 minutes), and Code of Conduct Training (45 minutes).

question: An employee booked a domestic hotel for $250 per night. Do they need special approval?
reference_answer: Yes. The domestic hotel limit is $200 per night. Costs above this limit require pre-approval from the department VP.

question: What is the total number of paid leave days a full-time employee receives per year across annual, sick, and casual leave?
reference_answer: A full-time employee receives 34 paid leave days per year: 18 days annual leave, 10 days sick leave, and 6 days casual leave.

question: What approval chain is required for a business trip estimated at $1,500?
reference_answer: A trip costing between $500 and $2,000 requires both manager and Director approval.

question: If an employee's company laptop is lost or stolen, what must they do?
reference_answer: If a company device is lost or stolen, the employee must report it immediately to security@nimbusworks.com and IT at it@nimbusworks.com.

question: Can an employee on a Performance Improvement Plan receive a merit increase?
reference_answer: No. Employees on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) are not eligible for merit increases during the PIP period.

question: If an employee wants to work remotely from abroad for 25 consecutive days, what must they do and how far in advance?
reference_answer: Employees may not work from outside their country of employment for more than 20 consecutive days without HR and Legal approval. For an extended period, they must submit a Remote Work Abroad Request form at least 6 weeks in advance.

question: What is the typical merit increase range for an employee rated 'Meets Expectations' (3) in the annual review?
reference_answer: Employees rated 3 (Meets Expectations) typically receive a merit increase of 3% to 5%.

question: What happens to annual leave days that exceed the 5-day carry-forward limit at year-end?
reference_answer: Any unused annual leave days beyond 5 at year-end are forfeited automatically.

question: What minimum performance rating and tenure is required to be eligible for promotion?
reference_answer: Employees must have been in their current role for at least 12 months and must have achieved a rating of 4 (Exceeds Expectations) or above in their most recent Annual Review to be eligible for promotion.

question: What is the dental insurance annual maximum benefit per person?
reference_answer: The dental insurance annual maximum benefit is $2,000 per person.

question: How many engineers are on the on-call rotation each week and how long is each rotation?
reference_answer: The on-call rotation consists of 2 engineers per week, rotating on a weekly basis with a Sunday midnight handoff.

question: What is the minimum tenure required before an engineer can join the on-call rotation?
reference_answer: Engineers joining the on-call rotation must have at least 6 months of tenure.

question: What is the minimum service length required to be eligible for maternity leave at NimbusWorks?
